title: Skillet Beef Fajitas
description: A flavorful and spicy beef dish made with argentinian-style beef strips and sautéed vegetables, served with a side of quick winey sauce.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Return the beef to the skillet and add the quick winey sauce.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
